data.rationale: The proposal follows the right sequence (OpenTable search, first restaurant, Allrecipes search, recipe time, new note) but it omits the "4+ stars" recipe criterion, the "don't click a time slot or Reserve" constraint, and the tab switching and note-typing specifics. It also lumps cuisine and area into one parameter and writes the note with "cook <dish>" instead of the recipe name, which makes the spec less automatable.
